title: The "live same-project duplicate" rule is hand-inlined in 7 places
description: Duplicate name-collision check exists in 7 locations (lib.rs 2776, 2978, 3900, 5053, 7236; cli_server.rs 2346, 967) with message re-spelled in multiple copies. Future policy changes will apply to only some copies, causing inconsistency in name validation across operations.

title: GUI New Task dialog can create duplicate task names
description: task_create_sync has no name check; only guards by directory path. Repo-root and imported-worktree tasks have no directory guard. GUI dialog lacks client-side validation (NewTaskDialog.tsx:915), allowing duplicate names in same project.

title: Test machine_help_covers_the_surface missing rename command
description: Expected-verb list does not include "rename". Test will not catch if rename command is dropped from subcommand tree or machine_help output in future refactors.
